text: the LORD: Heb. the face of the LORD
their enemies: Heb. those that rose up against them

For Moses had said, Consecrate yourselves today to the LORD, even every man upon his son, and upon his brother: Or, And Moses said, Consecrate yourselves today to the LORD, because every man hath been against his son, and against his brother, etc | Consecrate: Heb. fill your hands
